title: Trump cites India-Pakistan peace deal in new US national security blueprint
description: The Trump administration’s National Security Strategy renews the claim that Trump negotiated peace between India and Pakistan, a claim India rejects, while outlining deeper US–India cooperation across the Indo-Pacific and global alliances.

title: PM Modi points to Pakistan as root of Pahalgam, crocus terror attacks
description: India and Russia are standing together against terrorism. Prime Minister Modi stated that attacks in Pahalgam and Russia share the same root. Both nations are committed to fighting terrorism in all its forms. They will deepen cooperation to counter extremism, crime, and illicit activities. This partnership aims to eliminate terrorist safe havens and financing.

title: US National Security Strategy labels Trump 'President of Peace', falsely credits him for solving India-Pak conflict
description: The United States’ newly released National Security Strategy on Friday falsely claimed that President Donald Trump negotiated peace between India and Pakistan — a claim New Delhi has consistently rejected

title: US National Security Strategy falsely claims credit for solving India
description: The 33-page National Security Strategy document, signed by Donald Trump, repeated the claim that the US president brokered peace between India and Pakistan, a claim India disputes. Trump has repeatedly claimed to have mediated peace between India and Pakistan, despite India's denial of third-party involvement.

title: How cold war blunder pushed India into Soviet arms and why US refuses to learn
description: US favoritism toward Pakistan in the 1950s, driven by anti-Soviet fears, shattered India's trust, forging an Indo-Soviet alliance amid Nehru's non-alignment. History rhymes with Trump's tariff tensions.

title: India announces Air Force exercise near Pakistan's coastal airspace in Arabian Sea on these dates
description: The exercise area is situated roughly 70 nautical miles from Pakistan-controlled airspace, positioning it near a sensitive border area. This close proximity highlights the strategic importance of the drill and mirrors the complex security relationship between the two neighboring nations.

title: Putin punctures Pak narrative, says Taliban combat terrorism
description: Pakistan Afghanistan news: Russian President Vladimir Putin, in an exclusive interview with India Today Group, said that the Taliban in Afghanistan were a reality. He said the Taliban regime was combating terrorism. With this, Putin destroyed Islamabad's narrative of Afghan Taliban's role in terrorism in Pakistani territory, in which it tried to show an Indian role as well.

title: India Issues Notification For 2-Day Air Force Exercise Over Arabian Sea Close To Pakistani Airspace
description: India will run a 2‑day air force exercise in the Arabian Sea, 200 nautical miles from Karachi and only 70 nautical miles from Pakistan‑controlled airspace on December 10‑11.

title: India To Hold Air Force Exercise In Arabian Sea, 200 Nautical Miles Away From Pakistan
description: India has issued a notification for an Air Force exercise in the Arabian Sea, scheduled from Dec. 10 to 11, 2025. The designated danger zone lies approximately 200 nautical miles from Karachi, Pakistan, and about 70 nautical miles from Pakistan-controlled airspace, as per satellite imagery analyst Damien Symon.

title: Not Virat Kohli, This SA, Bangladesh & Pakistan Player Named ICC Player Of The Month For November
description: Harmer and Islam were instrumental in the Test series wins of South Africa and Bangladesh against India and Ireland respectively.
